title: Musk says SpaceX AI, Tesla will keep ordering Nvidia chips at scale
title_zh: 马斯克表示 SpaceX AI、特斯拉将继续大规模订购 Nvidia 芯片
summary: March 18 (Reuters) - Billionaire Elon Musk said late on Wednesday that his companies SpaceX AI and Tesla expect to continue ordering Nvidia chips at scale.
summary_zh: 3 月 18 日（路透社）——亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克周三晚间表示，他的公司 SpaceX AI 和特斯拉预计将继续大规模订购 Nvidia 芯片。

title: Apple's China smartphone sales jump 23% to start 2026, bucking industry trend
title_zh: 2026 年伊始，苹果中国智能手机销量逆行业趋势增长 23%
summary: Apple posted a 23% surge in China smartphone sales in the first nine weeks of ‌2026, bucking a broader market decline as some Android phone makers raised ‌prices in response to higher costs for memory chips.
summary_zh: 苹果公布 2026 年前 9 周中国智能手机销量激增 23%，尽管一些 Android 手机制造商因存储芯片成本上涨而提高价格，但市场整体下滑。

title: Nasdaq receives SEC nod for trading in tokenized securities
title_zh: 纳斯达克获得 SEC 批准代币化证券交易

title: Exclusive-Bridgewater's chief scientist Sekhon to join Google's DeepMind AI unit
title_zh: 独家——桥水首席科学家Sekhon加入谷歌DeepMind人工智能部门
summary: Jasjeet Sekhon, a top Bridgewater Associates executive, is joining Google's artificial intelligence unit DeepMind as its chief ‌strategy officer, DeepMind founder Demis Hassabis said on Wednesday.
summary_zh: DeepMind 创始人 Demis Hassabis 周三表示，桥水基金 (Bridgewater Associates) 高管 Jasjeet Sekhon 即将加入谷歌人工智能部门 DeepMind，担任首席战略官。

title: Wall Street ends sharply lower after Fed keeps rates unchanged
title_zh: 美联储维持利率不变后华尔街收跌
summary: STORY: Wall Street ended sharply lower on Wednesday, with the Dow dropping more than 1.6%, the S&P 500 shedding over 1.3% and the Nasdaq tumbling nearly one-and-a-half percent.The U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：周三华尔街股市大幅收低，道指跌幅超过 1.6%，标准普尔 500 指数跌幅超过 1.3%，纳斯达克指数跌幅接近百分之半。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall, oil surges after Iran, inflation worries sink stocks
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，伊朗局势后油价飙升，通胀担忧令股市下跌
summary: Major gauges are shrinking in the face of surging oil prices as the Fed decides whether to hold rates steady to combat inflation.
summary_zh: 随着美联储决定是否维持利率稳定以对抗通胀，面对油价飙升，主要指标正在萎缩。

title: Why this analyst says Micron's margins might be peaking
title_zh: 为什么这位分析师说美光的利润率可能已见顶
summary: Micron (MU) reported second quarter results and third quarter guidance on Wednesday that beat analyst estimates.
summary_zh: 美光科技 (MU) 周三公布了第二季度业绩和第三季度指引，超出了分析师的预期。

title: Nvidia's changing its strategic approach to AI, going all in on inferencing and agents
title_zh: Nvidia 正在改变其人工智能战略方法，全力投入推理和代理
summary: Nvidia is evolving to focus on inferencing and AI agents.
summary_zh: Nvidia 正在不断发展，专注于推理和人工智能代理。

title: BMW's new i3 EV takes on Tesla with 440-mile range
title_zh: 宝马新款 i3 电动汽车续航里程达 440 英里，与特斯拉展开较量
summary: BMW officially unveiled the new i3 EV on Wednesday, a sedan loaded with BMW's sport-oriented DNA and a Tesla-fighting 440 miles of estimated range.
summary_zh: 周三，宝马正式推出了新款 i3 EV，这是一款搭载宝马运动型 DNA 的轿车，预计续航里程可达 440 英里，可与特斯拉相媲美。
